name: @chewygumxx/skill-publishing-skills-to-npm
description: Publishes a repository's agent skills to an npm scope, one package per skill, released by release-please and published from CI by npm trusted publishing with provenance, and lists the mistakes that cost a failed run on the way. Use when packaging skills for npm or for `skills experimental_sync`, setting up, validating or debugging an npm trusted publisher or provenance, configuring release-please or its GitHub App for per-skill releases, or cutting, bootstrapping or verifying a skill's release.
